parsed.rationale: CSV export button on the invoice page returns a 500 error starting this morning; affects only the invoice page (not customer exports) and finance needs it fixed before Friday close.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi team, thanks for reporting this—sorry for the disruption. We understand the CSV export button on the invoice page started returning a 500 error this morning, while customer exports are still working, and you need the invoice export fixed before Friday close.

To help us pinpoint what’s failing, could you share the following details for the invoice CSV export?
1) The exact URL/route (or the button/action name) for the invoice export, if you have it.
2) Any request/response details from the 500 (e.g., the error message shown in the UI, and/or the server error returned in the browser network log).
3) Steps to reproduce (which invoice(s), how to click the export button), and whether it fails for all invoices or only certain ones.
4) Your user role/permissions used when reproducing.
5) Timestamp (and timezone) of when it first started, and whether anything changed around that time (deploy/config).

Once we have those, we’ll investigate and work to get the invoice export back to working reliably. In the meantime, thanks for confirming the manual workaround is available for now.
promised_actions: Investigate the invoice CSV export 500 error once the requested reproduction and error details are provided.
safety_notes: Did not promise a fix by Friday, a specific root cause, or a refund/SLA.
Requested the minimum additional information needed to proceed (endpoint/action, error details, repro steps, permissions, and timeline).
No security or legal determinations were made.
